reference.title: Scenario 17: Block image between numbered list in a procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider creating a new alarm notification procedure where a screenshot is inserted after a step

section.p: Consider creating a new alarm notification procedure where a screenshot is inserted after a step to show the expected result before the user continues.

table.title: Block image between a numbered list (procedure)

entry.codeblock: # Creating a New Alarm Notification 1. Click **Add Notification**. ![Add Notification Dialog](images/add-notification.png) 2. Enter the notification details. 3. Click **Save**.

<task id="creating_a_new_alarm_notification"> <title>Creating a New Alarm Notification</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Click <uicontrol>Add Notification</uicontrol>.</cmd> <info> <image href="media/add-notification.png"> <alt>Add Notification Dialog</alt> </image> </info> </step> <step> <cmd>Enter the notification details.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Click <uicontrol>Save</uicontrol>.</cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result:The converter associates the image with the preceding procedural step and places it inside an <info> element within the corresponding DITA <step>. The image becomes supporting information for that step.
